mprStructureToParameter.Description: Transferring the structure of a multilayer type to a multiline parameter
mprStructureToParameter.Description1: Transferring of layer volumes of multilayer elements into a multiline parameter
mprStructureToParameter.t1: Search by type or material name:
mprStructureToParameter.t2: Show only Types with required parameters
mprStructureToParameter.t4: Usable are the Types used in at least one instance of the element in the model

mprStructureToParameter.t8: Number of uses of the material in other Types (loaded in the plugin), including the current Type
mprStructureToParameter.t15: Number of Types loaded in the plugin
mprStructureToParameter.t17: Number of Types displayed in table with all filters
mprStructureToParameter.t19: Number of displayed Types with filled in parameter "Template"

mprStructureToParameter.t32: {0} – material name. {1} – layer thickness. {2} – variable thickness. {3} - number of layers
mprStructureToParameter.t36: Required type parameter with the data type "Multiline text". This parameter specifies the template of result formation. To output the list of structure layers in the template, it is necessary to specify the structure wildcard
mprStructureToParameter.t37: Required type parameter with the data type "Multiline text". In this type parameter, a numbered list of structure layers is written, taking into account the specified line formats and numbering settings
mprStructureToParameter.t38: Optional type parameter with data type "Text". This type parameter specifies a custom variable thickness value that can be used in string format for a variable thickness layer
mprStructureToParameter.t39: The wildcard specified in the template, which is replaced by a formatted list of structure layers in the result
mprStructureToParameter.t42: Take material name from material parameter:
mprStructureToParameter.t44: Optional type parameter with the data type "Multiline Text". The same result is written to this parameter as to the "Result" parameter, but in reverse order. The parameter is processed if the type being processed has it
mprStructureToParameter.t46: Required instance parameter with the data type "Multiline text". In this parameter, a numbered list of volumes of the structure layers is written, taking into account the specified line formats and numbering settings
mprStructureToParameter.t53: Structure placeholders specified in the template
mprStructureToParameter.t54: @ - required, used to substitute a formatted list of structure layers in the result
mprStructureToParameter.t55: & - optional, used to substitute a formatted list of merged structure layers in the result
mprStructureToParameter.t56: [n] - optional, used to specify the indices of layers that will be used to substitute a formatted list of structure layers in the result
mprStructureToParameter.t57: ^ - optional, used to define a subtitle for layers. Specified before @. A string written after ^ will not be included in the numbering of structure layers in the result
mprStructureToParameter.t60: Required type parameter with the data type "Multiline text". This parameter contains a numbered list of the total volumes of the structure layers, taking into account the specified line formats and numbering settings
mprStructureToParameter.t64: Change the value of the specified material parameter To enable the possibility to change the value activate the "Take material name from material parameter" option in the string format settings
